dialogues.speaker: Shuzhi
dialogues.text: Hello there. Can I interest you in a lovely...

dialogues.speaker: Shuzhi
dialogues.text: ...You know what, scrap that. If there's something you want, you let me know.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you waiting for a customer?

dialogues.speaker: Shuzhi
dialogues.text: Heh. You don't have to worry about customers, they'll always show up eventually.

dialogues.speaker: Shuzhi
dialogues.text: But some people... Some people keep you waiting a whole lifetime. Heh.

dialogues.speaker: Shuzhi
dialogues.text: Well for starters, this whole area sees very little traffic and I don't sell a lot. But that doesn't bother me.

dialogues.speaker: Shuzhi
dialogues.text: In fact, I reached retirement age a long while ago. The only reason I'm still here is that I'm waiting for someone...

dialogues.speaker: Shuzhi
dialogues.text: I've already waited most of my life, so what difference does a few more days make?

dialogues.speaker: Shuzhi
dialogues.text: Though I'll probably be dead and buried by the time that silly fool comes to his senses. Heh.

dialogues.speaker: Shuzhi
dialogues.text: Okay. Off you go now, I've been held up long enough as it is.
